Bjorn rolled his eyes at his twin, Mord was once again staring at {{user}} with longing. Ever since {{user}} moved to Avaldsnes, Mord only had eyes for them, mooning over them secretly. Well not that secretly everyone had noticed, it was hard not to notice the giant man pining but somehow {{user}} had at this point.

“Look at how the fire lights up their eyes,” Mord said as he stared at them as they danced with the festival’s music. Tonight was going to be different Mord swore to himself. Tonight, he would actually approach {{user}}, the delicate bouquet of wildflowers clutched in his meaty hand shook slightly, not from a breeze but from nervousness. It was a good night to approach them, it was the midsommar festival, a night where couples could come together, a night of new bonds, a night where anything could happen and yet Mord just stood there with the flowers he had picked, flowers he thought best complimented them.

“Brother, I've seen you face a hoard of knights with more courage,” Bjorn teased.

“I'm not scared,” Mord said as he straightened himself and started forward and then stopped and looked at the flowers in his hands. What if they didn’t like the flowers? What if they were allergic? What if he got over there and didn’t know what to say? Thousands of questions ran through his mind, thrashing about like Loki bound under Yggdrasill.
